description:
Are you a dynamic and results-driven Marketing Director looking for an exciting opportunity in a recently acquired skilled nursing facility? We are seeking a highly motivated individual to lead our marketing efforts and drive census growth in Sarasota County, FL. This role is perfect for a proactive professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to making a significant impact.

As Marketing Director, you will be instrumental in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies, building strong community relationships, and enhancing our facility's presence. The ideal candidate is a 'hustler' – someone who is presentable, driven, and willing to work occasional weekends to achieve outstanding results. We offer excellent compensation for the right individual who can demonstrate a proven track record of success.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and achieve marketing objectives.
Professional demeanor and excellent communication skills.
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed.
A proactive, results-oriented approach to marketing and community outreach.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and proven track record.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier home healthcare provider in Billings, MT. This role offers the flexibility of both full-time and part-time schedules, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life while delivering high-quality patient care in a home setting. You will be an integral part of a team committed to improving patient outcomes and promoting independence.

This is an excellent opportunity for an RN looking for a rewarding career with a competitive salary. You will utilize your clinical expertise to provide comprehensive nursing services, health education, and support to patients in their homes, fostering a comfortable and familiar environment for recovery and wellness.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana
Minimum of 1-2 years of clinical experience, preferably in home health
Strong assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $125,000, based on experience and contract type.

facilityType: Workers' Compensation and No-Fault Medical Group
description:
Join a dynamic medical group in New York City, specializing in workers' compensation and no-fault cases across multiple locations including Harlem, the Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens, and Long Island. This Internal Medicine MD role offers a competitive compensation package around $180,000 per year, with a significant emphasis on performance-based bonuses. We are seeking a dedicated physician who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to providing exceptional care to patients involved in workers' compensation and no-fault claims.

This position requires a physician who is comfortable working weekends and possesses a strong understanding of the unique aspects of workers' compensation and no-fault cases. You will be part of a team that does not handle major medical insurance, Medicare, or Medicaid, allowing for a focused practice area. If you are WCB certified and have experience in this specialized field, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) degree and valid New York State medical license
Workers' Compensation Board (WCB) certification is required
Proven experience with workers' compensation or no-fault/lien cases
Ability to work weekends as part of the regular schedule
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation around $180,000 per year, heavily weighted towards bonuses rather than base salary.

description:
Join a dynamic team of healthcare professionals as a Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PM&R) Physician, serving patients across multiple rehabilitation clinics in the vibrant Bronx/Westchester, NY area. This unique opportunity allows you to dedicate 1-2 days a week at various facilities, providing comprehensive care without extensive travel outside the region. We are seeking a physician with a strong background in workers' compensation or no-fault/lien cases, as our practice does not engage with major medical insurances, Medicare, or Medicaid.

This role offers a highly attractive compensation package, heavily weighted towards performance-based bonuses, with a starting annual compensation of $300,000+. We value physicians who are committed to patient recovery and are able to provide care on weekends to meet patient needs. If you are a WCB-certified PM&R Physician with a passion for rehabilitation and a focus on workers' compensation, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Valid New York State Medical License
Board Certified or Board Eligible in Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation
Minimum of 2 years of experience with workers' compensation or no-fault/lien cases
Ability to work weekends as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $300,000+ per year, with a structure heavily weighted towards performance-based bonuses.
